newsitem.title: USA: InterVoice sees lower Q1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: InterVoice sees lower Q1 earnings.

text.p: InterVoice Inc said on Wednesday that it expects its earnings for the first quarter ended May 31, 1997, to be between $0.02 and $0.04 a share, which is below last year's first quarter earnings per share of $0.24.
First quarter revenues are expected to be between $24.5 million and $25.0 million, compared with $25.6 million in last year's first quarter, InterVoice said.
InterVoice said it continued to invest in marketing and research and development during the first quarter.
The increased investment in infrastructure and lower than anticipated revenues, resulted in decreased earnings as compared to the same quarter last year, InterVoice said.

The company said a major sale that it was expecting to close in the first quarter will close in the second. The sale would have pushed the company's earnings over most published earnings estimates for the quarter, InterVoice said.
As with any sales opportunity, InterVoice said it cannot be sure when, or if, the deal will close.
First Call's consensus analyst earnings estimates for the quarter was $0.17 a share.
